Hi! I'm Jasmin. I post videos about fitness, nutrition, stress management, DIY & useful hacks, CAT STUFF (especially kitty nutrition, health, raw cat food, and cute kitty vids), and whatever else I feel like sharing. Subscribe if you want to join the fun 😻

Panda hugs & slow blinks ❤
Jasmin, Puppy, Alfred, Betty & Ronin (and Pepper)


Business inquiries: hello@truehealthtrifecta.com

👁👁👁

Disclaimer & Liability Release: I am not a licensed veterinarian or vet tech - I am a cat owner, lover, and avid independent researcher in regards to the cat nutrition and care information shared.  By taking any advice given, you are also agreeing to take full responsibility for your cat's health and well-being. When seeking medical advice for your fur babies, always consult with your vet first :)
